title: Product lockup + CTA
description: Transactional voucher journeys where the user needs one-tap access to their offer.
usage: Header for voucher / offer journeys. FreeStyle Libre 3 Plus lockup with a persistent utility CTA. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.

images.notes: FreeStyle Libre 3 Plus lockup, charcoal type. Transparent PNG, contain.

notes: Desktop: logo left, yellow CTA right. Mobile (≤480px): both columns carry drop + centered and stack; the logo and button sit in centered m-auto tables so they centre. The button gets 10px above it (padd-none) vs 8px in Figma.
Padding: sides 48→32 (mobPad32). Figma grows the vertical padding from 16 to 24 on mobile; top snaps to 20 (himobtop), bottom has no ADC class near 24 and stays 16.
Yellow button has no colour changes. VML width 216px.
Single (light) logo; dark mode is left to the inbox.
